rule: Exploratory detector fixed before the full-grid scan and after isolated-window diagnosis. Per band, channel and exposure, subtract channel median per cumulative read difference. Estimate pixel-level center and robust scale using the other 29 exposures. Require a positive excursion at read 1 and persistence at reads 5 and 10 of half the first excess, also exceeding the independent scale threshold at each read. Exclude any sample at the representation rails; use identical rule throughout.
